chapter: Opinions, Edgar Battle and closing stories
title: Edgar Battle: hiring him for Blanche and composing 'Topsy'

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: We can't end this interview without talking a little bit about your friend Edgar Battle. We mentioned him in passing a number of times but we never really delved.

Well Edgar Battle is, I finished telling you a little while ago that he was a very dear friend. Edgar Battle I've been knowing him, he is the one that recruited me out of New York to go with Blanche Calloway.
He was with Blanche and he says, Cozy, would you like to join Blanche Calloway, which was really my first band that I stayed with and got experience.

That's right. So Battle is the one that hired me for that job, and I imagine that Blanche at the time wanted to fire me one million times because I didn't know what segue meant. And you know the del segno signs and all that. And I had never played a show and Battles was very boisterous. You fire him, I'm the one that hired him, fire me too. So constant going on, couple, three months from there, playing shows and things like that is when I started to learn how to play shows. And from then on, you know, I was in the know. I mean I knew how to play shows, I knew how to segue and I got used to playing with the big bands. So, we were together, Battles and I worked together for a few years, then we both quit. Blanche was always on us about where'd Battles would always be telling, well you know, if you don't want to work for me I'll get the boy round the corner. And so as long as you can get musicians a dime a dozen here, you know. So anyway we used to sit in back of the bus and Battles and I quit Blanche Calloway at the same time. And it was down in Nashville, Tennessee, and we just took a Greyhound bus, put my drums there, then they had the carrier up on top of the buses then, the Greyhound buses, and came

to New York, and then's when I joined Benny Carter, and then later on after Benny Carter, I went with Willy Bryant and Battles was in that band with Willy Bryant. So in the meantime, during all that time, I've been seeing Battles, knowing him, and believe it or not, when I got this number together, 'Topsy', and mentioned it, and we had recorded, I didn't know Battles was the composer.
Isn't that something. I found out afterwards Battles was the composer.
